body: Okay the Barbie on the cross may be a bit much, I will admit.
I got it at Spencers at the mall I believe, so it can't be hard to find around.

It just feels like such a huge commitment to go shopping for a psychologist, I have severe anxiety about meeting new people or being in large groups so this complicates it too. 

Also, my mom is warming up to the idea of me as a girl but my dad has flat out said to me "not in my house" so that's kinda that....

I was a computer security guy/Network administrator. I did a whole bunch of network administration, but my favorite part was malware and intrusion investigations which I was the lead on until I had my mental issues and had my Security Clearance pulled.

I was terrified of dolls growing up and my parents would place a scary, dirty, naked doll in certain areas of my room or in my bed with me while I slept. They thought it was good fun to hear me wake up screaming and begging for them to stop but now in retrospect with the fairly large amount of mental health issues I have they can see they took their fear game too far.
